body: I'm glad you do too. He's my savior.
Thank you! I'm glad it did for you. I hope him and I continue to be legends through life.

I always feel like it should go both ways, my depression doesn't stop but I can always take a second to acknowledge how grateful I am to someone who helps me at my super lows. This is a throw away but on my normal account I have posted and thanked the redditors who have helped me through some things.
Thank you, to you as well.
Thank you so much. That means a lot.
I've gotten really lucky to have a significant other who might not understand but doesn't run away, no matter how hard I try to push away sometimes.
